svg.title: workstation-steward: a host audit, then tidying up after the soak
svg.desc: An illustrative session, looping, in three scenes. steward sc audit checks the mise toolchain, the release-age gate, Homebrew, apps, trust stores, Docker and indicators of compromise (trimmed to one line each), and ends with three actions: a gated mise release, a browser to update now, and a container on a floating tag. Three days after an upgrade, the steward banner and steward sc soak say the soak is over. steward sc prune lists the old versions no config needs, previews the removal, asks, and removes them.

text.tspan: mise: 2026.10.18 -> 2026.10.19 (3d old): steward sc upgrade-tool mise
Release-age gate (steward.toml is the authority; mise and Renovate must agree)
Apps (bundle version vs Homebrew cask catalog; Electron vs its 3 supported majors)
app: Google Chrome 155.0.8059.86 -> 156.0.8078.74 (0d old; always_current: update now)
emSign ECC Root CA - G3 (default): in macOS system roots, admin trust setting = Deny
docker: container ollama runs floating ollama/ollama:latest; pin tag@digest
Indicators of compromise (ioc: the engine's defaults and yours; read-only)
Next: steward sc plan (Homebrew + mise); apps, App Store, macOS and trust are manual.
